run_crystal_structure_relaxation: run crystal structure relaxation on CIF files using the UMA ML potential via the argparse CLI
create_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator with a pretrained UMA model for structure relaxation
get_relax_config_and_dir: get relaxation parameters and output directory path from a workflow configuration dictionary
relax_atoms: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS optimizers
run_relax_jobs: submit parallel SLURM jobs to relax crystal structures from parquet files using submitit
